status.en: 23 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 64% more than the week before, most of them in Kivu, Kinshasa and Kigali.
status.nb: 23 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 64 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Kivu, Kinshasa og Kigali.

summary.en: M23 rebels have pulled back from near Bunia after heavy clashes, while fighting intensifies elsewhere as they open a new front near the Uganda border and target Uvira city. WHO evacuated its Ebola response team from a hospital in Ituri after the team was trapped by fighting, and the Ebola death rate is now near 50%. A Congolese military aircraft went missing, with rebels claiming they shot it down, leading to the capture of a South African mercenary and the reported capture of Ugandan and South African nationals. Kenya and the DRC have agreed to restore diplomatic ties after recent tensions. The conflict has displaced 8.2 million people, according to DNE Africa.
summary.nb: M23‑opprørerne har trukket seg tilbake fra området ved Bunia etter tunge kamper, mens kampene intensiveres andre steder ettersom de åpner en ny front ved grensen mot Uganda og tar sikte på byen Uvira. WHO evakuerte sitt ebolateam fra et sykehus i Ituri etter at teamet ble fanget i kampene, og eboladødsraten er nå nær 50 %. Et kongolesisk militærfly forsvant, og opprørerne hevder at de skjøt det ned, noe som førte til at en sørafrikansk leiesoldat ble tatt til fange og at ugandiske og sørafrikanske statsborgere skal ha blitt tatt til fange. Kenya og DRC har blitt enige om å gjenopprette diplomatiske forbindelser etter nylige spenninger. Konflikten har fordrevet 8.2 millioner mennesker, ifølge DNE Africa.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
